title: Open a subagent in the Claude pane to see its own steps
notes: Claude Code: the transcript and agent view show a subagent's own steps. SDK: getSubagentMessages (sdk.d.ts:963), forwardSubagentText (1921), agentProgressSummaries (2134). Pane: subagent messages are dropped (chat-transcript.ts:223); the task strip shows a summary only. Size M.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #107: unfolding an Agent call lists the subagent's own text and tool calls, a skill it loaded as one line, a nested subagent indented under its line. Thinking stays out of a subagent's steps.
